_comment: Copy this to data/family.json and fill it with your own households. data/family.json is gitignored and this example is the only file under data/ that git tracks. Every id here is arbitrary, but the cross-references have to line up: the app refuses a file whose joins do not hold.
_pause: The pause block on a service is what somebody recorded by walking that provider's flow by hand. Leave it out until you have walked it: no block means the app offers no button, which is the honest answer. method is native-pause, cancel-resubscribe or store-managed. maxPauseMonths belongs to native-pause and nowhere else. costs lists what stopping loses beyond money, from downloads, watch-list, profiles, grandfathered-price and annual-term-forfeit, and an empty list means you checked and found nothing.
_subscriptions: status is active or paused, and leaving it out means active. A paused row must carry pausedOn, and should carry resumeBy so the app can raise the date before somebody loses a show. lastUsedOn is self-declared: leaving it out means nobody has answered, which is not the same as nobody watching.
